import sys

def solve():
    t = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    
    if t <= 0:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    # Cycle n has length 2n and starts at time (n-1)^2
    # The value at the start of cycle n is 3 * 2^(n-1)
    
    # Find which cycle t belongs to
    # End time of cycle n: sum of lengths = 2 + 4 + 6 + ... + 2n = n(n+1)
    cycle = 1
    while cycle * (cycle + 1) < t:
        cycle += 1
    
    # Start time of this cycle
    start_time = (cycle - 1) * cycle
    
    # Initial value of this cycle
    initial_value = 3 * (2 ** (cycle - 1))
    
    # Value at time t
    offset = t - start_time
    value = initial_value - offset
    
    print(value)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
